expectation: Membrane ring on B cells, a minority population. In gut tissue like this they should sit in clustered lymphoid follicles or aggregates, with few single cells in the epithelium or the rest of the tissue.
observed: A: sparse yellow specks plus a few bright compact blobs (aggregate-sized) on the tissue. B and C: essentially empty. D: a cluster of cells with membrane-outlined yellow rings and dim nuclei. E1: no CD20 where CD19 is dense; CD19 is only a faint haze.
why: D shows a membrane-pattern cluster and A has a few aggregate-like blobs, but most signal is sparse specks and CD19 co-expression is not supported.
